plan.notes: Transcribed 2026-11-13 from the official Southern Utah University 2026-2027 General Catalog (current edition, catoid=28) Integrative Health Sciences program page (poid=11094) and its linked official degree map, 'Integrative Health Sciences Degree Maps (2026-2027)', tab 'Integrative Health Sciences (Campus)' (the workbook's Index lists Online as N/A for this program), last updated/reviewed July 31, 2026. Semester placement is the university's official sample 4-year campus academic plan (SUU Program Maps, 2026-2027), which the source itself labels a guide only; students confirm specifics in Degree Works with a Student Success Advisor. Every semester's courses sum to the map's printed semester total (15/14/16/15/15/16/15/14) and the plan to the catalog's printed Total Credits, BS Degree: 120. Per the catalog, all courses must be passed with a C- (1.7) or better to be counted in the major. The catalog's Integrative Health Sciences Curriculum (72-73 credits) is exercised exactly by the map: the Integrative Health Core at 49 credits (every named core course placed, the Introductory Development choice, the Technical Writing choice and the 3-credit Internship/Practicum choice carried as choice slots, and the Human Physiology Lab placed as the map's BIOL 2425 row with the catalog's BIOL 2423 online alternative carried on the slot) and the Integrative Health Electives at 24 credits in the map's eight 3-credit elective rows, the four Year 4 rows satisfying the block's 12-credit upper-division minimum exactly. DISCLOSED catalog range, not reconciled: the Core is headed 48-49 credits because PE 1543 Advanced First Aid-Emergency Care-CPR (1 credit) may be satisfied instead by a current card of completion at graduation, as the catalog page itself states; the map takes the class and the plan records it at 1 credit, so the Core is recorded at 49 and the Curriculum at 73. The catalog's Bachelor of Science requirement (12 credits) and General Education requirement (28+ credits) overlap the major and the free electives, as the catalog's own notes state, so the catalog blocks do not sum arithmetically to 120; the map's free-elective rows (25 credits) carry the balance exactly as printed.
